facts.business: HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited (HCG) operates an integrated cancer care network of 25 hospitals across 19 cities in India and 1 in Kenya, providing expert-led oncology and precision-guided care across the continuum from early detection and diagnosis to treatment, rehabilitation and survivorship.

segments.name: Oncology, precision diagnostics and multi-speciality businesses (continuing operations)

capacity_or_capex.timeline: As at 31 March 2026: approximately 3,100 beds, with 2,734 operational beds; spare capacity of ~400 beds to be operationalized in next 3-4 years
Approximately 200+ additional beds planned over next 24 months across Bengaluru, Cuttack, Ranchi and Vizag
Up to 132 beds equipped with MR-LINAC technology, commenced operations in May 2026

capacity_or_capex.item: Brownfield bed additions at Ahmedabad and Bhavnagar

key_risks: Macroeconomic conditions, changes in government policies and pricing regulations, evolving competitive dynamics, delays in project execution, challenges in obtaining regulatory approvals, availability of skilled human resources and capital
Payor mix and collection risks including delays, disallowances, changes in reimbursement policies
Competition from specialized and multispecialty providers expanding oncology capabilities
Talent attraction, retention and development in specialized oncology disciplines
Goodwill and intangible asset impairment risk from past acquisitions
Financing constraints and changes in borrowing costs
